prose: The Information reports that Google is paying roughly 100 digital publishers based on how much their content contributes to AI Overviews, AI Mode and Gemini, in a pilot whose payments vary widely. The source could not be retrieved (the fetch returned an error), so payment ranges and publisher names are unavailable; this summary is based on the headline and feed excerpt.
highlights: Google paying ~100 digital publishers for content contributions to AI products
Covers AI Overviews, AI Mode and Gemini; payments vary widely
Source unreachable at fetch time; summary based on headline and feed excerpt
